image_description: A macro close-up of a tiger beetle perched on a textured, light-brown organic surface (likely wood or bark). The beetle exhibits vibrant metallic green and bronze coloration with iridescent sheen. Visible features include large compound eyes, long filiform antennae, prominent mandibles, and slender legs gripping the surface. The background is softly blurred (bokeh), emphasizing the subject.
